label: Elnathan

text.BHSA 2KI 24:7: וְלֹֽא־הֹסִ֥יף עֹוד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָצֵ֖את מֵֽאַרְצֹ֑ו כִּֽי־לָקַ֞ח מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל מִנַּ֤חַל מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד־נְהַר־פְּרָ֔ת כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לְמֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ פ
text.KJV 2KI 24:7: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
text.BHSA 2KI 24:8: בֶּן־שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהֹויָכִ֣ין בְּמָלְכֹ֔ו וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמֹּ֔ו נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת־אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
text.KJV 2KI 24:8: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
text.BHSA 2KI 24:9: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽיו׃
text.KJV 2KI 24:9: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

A.name: Elnathan
A.line: from Jerusalem, father of Nehushta (2KI 24:8), an official (JER 36:12)

B.name: Elnathan
B.line: Of Jerusalem; father of Nehushta, maternal grandfather of king Jehoiachin.

why: בַת־אֶלְנָתָן מִירוּשָׁלָם identifies Elnathan as Nehushta’s father from Jerusalem, exactly as B states. A states the same identifying facts, however, and neither this verse nor its neighbors establishes the additional Achbor connection, so the choice of B is uncertain.
